in_hindi.long_meaning: विजयी जिसने सोता लक्ह विजय पाया है (Vijayi jisane sota lakha vijay paya hai)

in_marathi.name: Lakhyajit
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Victory
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lakhyajit हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lakshya means goal or target, and Jit means victory. Lakhyajit means God of Victory, or the one who achieves his goal.

in_bengali.name: Lakhyajit
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Victory
in_bengali.long_meaning: Lakhyajit একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Lakshya means goal or target, and Jit means victory. Lakhyajit means God of Victory, or the one who achieves his goal.
